patch_automation_enabled.title: Patch Deployment Automation Enabled
patch_automation_enabled.description: Whether automated patch deployment scheduling is enabled in the patch management system, requiring no manual trigger for standard patch cycles including critical and high severity OS patches.

patch_compliance_percentage.title: Patch Compliance Percentage
patch_compliance_percentage.description: The percentage of in-scope systems that are fully patched (all critical and high severity CVEs applied) within the organization's defined SLA window.

critical_patch_sla_days.title: Critical Patch SLA (Days)
critical_patch_sla_days.description: The configured maximum number of days from patch release to deployment for critical severity patches, as defined in organizational policy and enforced by tooling. Also used as the worst-case deployment window across managed endpoints.

patch_compliance_tracking_enabled.title: Patch Compliance Tracking Enabled
patch_compliance_tracking_enabled.description: Whether the patch management system actively tracks and reports compliance status (patched vs. unpatched) across all managed endpoints against defined SLAs.

rollback_capability_available.title: Rollback Capability Available
rollback_capability_available.description: Whether the patch management system supports rolling back applied patches in the event of system instability or incompatibility, with documented and tested procedures.

compliance_dashboard_enabled.title: Compliance Dashboard Enabled
compliance_dashboard_enabled.description: Whether a centralized patch compliance dashboard is active and aggregating patch status across managed endpoints.

unpatched_system_reporting_enabled.title: Unpatched System Reporting Enabled
unpatched_system_reporting_enabled.description: Whether the system generates reports or alerts identifying endpoints that are lagging behind the required patch compliance level.

inventory_coverage_percent.title: Patch Inventory Coverage Percentage
inventory_coverage_percent.description: Percentage of total managed endpoints currently visible in the centralized patch compliance dashboard.

report_staleness_days.title: Compliance Report Staleness (Days)
report_staleness_days.description: Number of days since the last patch compliance report or dashboard refresh was completed.

patch_deployment_cadence_days.title: Patch Deployment Cadence (Days)
patch_deployment_cadence_days.description: Maximum number of days between public CVE disclosure and patch deployment for critical/high severity vulnerabilities, as defined in patch management policy and measured in practice.

rollback_capability_enabled.title: Patch Rollback Capability Enabled
rollback_capability_enabled.description: Indicates whether the patch management system has rollback capability configured, allowing restoration to a known-good state if a patch causes instability.

pre_deployment_testing_stage.title: Pre-Deployment Testing Stage
pre_deployment_testing_stage.description: Represents the level of pre-deployment patch testing performed before patches are pushed to production systems.

rollback_test_frequency_days.title: Rollback Procedure Test Frequency (Days)
rollback_test_frequency_days.description: Number of days since rollback procedures were last validated through a drill or actual rollback event. A value of 0 means never tested.

patch_logging_enabled.title: Patch Logging Enabled
patch_logging_enabled.description: Whether the patch management system is configured to log patch installation events, including success, failure, and skip outcomes.

log_retention_days.title: Patch Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: The number of days patch installation logs are retained before deletion or archival, supporting forensic and compliance needs.

log_storage_destination.title: Patch Log Storage Destination
log_storage_destination.description: Where patch logs are stored, indicating whether they are centralized and tamper-resistant or only local to the endpoint.

audit_fields_captured.title: Audit Fields Captured in Patch Logs
audit_fields_captured.description: List of data fields recorded per patch event, such as timestamp, patch ID, system hostname, user/service account, and outcome.

third_party_patch_scope_enabled.title: Third-Party Component Patch Scope Enabled
third_party_patch_scope_enabled.description: Whether the patch management system is configured to cover OS-bundled third-party libraries, drivers, and dependent components beyond the core kernel.

third_party_patch_compliance_rate.title: Third-Party Component Patch Compliance Rate (%)
third_party_patch_compliance_rate.description: Percentage of managed endpoints with third-party OS-bundled components patched within the defined SLA window.

third_party_patch_automation_mode.title: Third-Party Patch Automation Mode
third_party_patch_automation_mode.description: The automation level applied to third-party component patching within the patch management system.

hardened_baseline_defined.title: Hardened Baseline Defined
hardened_baseline_defined.description: Whether a documented, approved hardened configuration baseline exists for patched systems.

post_patch_compliance_validation.title: Post-Patch Compliance Validation
post_patch_compliance_validation.description: Whether systems are automatically or manually checked against the hardened baseline after patches are applied.

configuration_drift_detection_enabled.title: Configuration Drift Detection Enabled
configuration_drift_detection_enabled.description: Whether continuous or scheduled monitoring detects deviation from the approved baseline after patching.
